file_grants_state_check.name: file_grants_state_check
file_grants_state_check.value:
(
        "file_grants"."recipient_user_id" is null
        and "file_grants"."activation_deadline" is not null
      )
      or
      (
        "file_grants"."recipient_user_id" is not null
        and "file_grants"."activation_deadline" is null
      )

file_grants_activation_before_expiry_che.name: file_grants_activation_before_expiry_check
file_grants_activation_before_expiry_che.value:
"file_grants"."activation_deadline" is null
      or "file_grants"."expires_at" is null
      or "file_grants"."activation_deadline" <= "file_grants"."expires_at"

object_deletion_jobs_terminal_state_chec.name: object_deletion_jobs_terminal_state_check
object_deletion_jobs_terminal_state_chec.value: not ("object_deletion_jobs"."completed_at" is not null and "object_deletion_jobs"."failed_at" is not null)

upload_intents_mode_check.name: upload_intents_mode_check
upload_intents_mode_check.value:
(
        "upload_intents"."upload_mode" = 'single'
        and "upload_intents"."checksum_type" = 'full_sha256'
        and "upload_intents"."expected_sha256" is not null
        and "upload_intents"."upload_url_expires_at" is not null
        and "upload_intents"."s3_upload_id" is null
        and "upload_intents"."part_size_bytes" is null
        and "upload_intents"."part_count" is null
      )
      or
      (
        "upload_intents"."upload_mode" = 'multipart'
        and "upload_intents"."checksum_type" = 'composite_sha256'
        and "upload_intents"."expected_sha256" is null
        and "upload_intents"."upload_url_expires_at" is null
        and "upload_intents"."s3_upload_id" is not null
        and char_length(btrim("upload_intents"."s3_upload_id")) > 0
        and "upload_intents"."part_size_bytes" is not null
        and "upload_intents"."part_size_bytes" > 0
        and "upload_intents"."part_count" is not null
        and "upload_intents"."part_count" between 2 and 10000
      )

upload_intents_completion_state_check.name: upload_intents_completion_state_check
upload_intents_completion_state_check.value:
(
        "upload_intents"."status" = 'completed'
        and "upload_intents"."file_id" is not null
        and "upload_intents"."completed_at" is not null
      )
      or
      (
        "upload_intents"."status" <> 'completed'
        and "upload_intents"."file_id" is null
        and "upload_intents"."completed_at" is null
      )

upload_intents_operation_target_check.name: upload_intents_operation_target_check
upload_intents_operation_target_check.value:
(
        "upload_intents"."operation" = 'create'
        and "upload_intents"."file_name" is not null
        and "upload_intents"."target_file_id" is null
        and "upload_intents"."expected_content_version" is null
      ) 
      or 
      (
        "upload_intents"."operation" = 'replace'
        and "upload_intents"."file_name" is null
        and "upload_intents"."target_parent_id" is null
        and "upload_intents"."target_file_id" is not null
        and "upload_intents"."expected_content_version" is not null
        and "upload_intents"."expected_content_version" > 0
      )
